title: The Episode About Slaughter and Arson at Sadhaura

blocks.text: The poet explains why the pir’s body could finally burn: Banda says he learned a fuller fire-mantra from Aluni Sidh, while the pir knew only enough to restrain fire partially and temporarily.

With Sadhaura closed, the narrative opens Episode 37 and shifts from miracle to rumor, recording how people begin talking about Banda as an avatār, a wonder-worker, or a terrifying new manifestation in the world.
Wazir Khan is shaken by these reports, so Episode 37 begins in fear and speculation before the next military confrontation is fully described. Episode 37 is explicitly opened here.
